svg.title: Offline wake evaluation and evidence boundaries
svg.desc: A private WAV corpus and verified frozen model feed the existing detector. Positive labels support matched detections and misses, negative labels support false accepts per scored hour, and unlabeled clips support observations only. Reports preserve domain separation and provenance. Real-room acceptance needs additional labeled evidence.
svg.text: Measure the detector. Keep the evidence boundaries.
Local files only · No recording, phone activation, HA calls, or model downloads
Private corpus
16 kHz, mono PCM16 WAV + explicit labels and time windows
Keep synthetic, noise, TV, music, and speech domains distinct
Unlabeled audio can be inspected; it cannot establish accuracy.
Frozen model and frontend
Verify all three ONNX hashes and the bundle threshold
Record frontend source, constants, runtime, and input hashes
No replacement preprocessing or threshold calibration
Reuse the existing streaming detector
Reset per clip → feed exact 80 ms hops → collect scores and activations
First score at 1.28 s · preserve the 19-hop refractory interval
Report warm-up and incomplete tail; never hide them with padding.
Positive, timed labels
One event ↔ at most one activation
Matched / missed events and timing
Incomplete windows are not silently
counted as misses.
Explicit negative labels
False activations / scored hours
Show exposure and event counts
Retain per-domain results. Zero observed
events is not proof of zero future risk.
Unlabeled clips
Activation times and scores only
No true / false outcome or accuracy
A triggered classifier alone cannot
verify which phrase caused it.
Private, reproducible report
Clip results + domain metrics + coverage + exact model and data provenance
Real-room acceptance is a later, separately labeled evaluation.
Include speakers, distances, noise, TV, music, and the phone codec path. Hearing a reply is a different check.
